_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: rathole
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A fast reverse tunnel, like frp or ngrok: exposes services behind NAT through this server. Clients sign in with a random token, made at install in server.toml.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# rathole: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub
# (checked against GitHub's checksum) and writes a first server.toml with a
# random token. server.toml is never touched; only the program is replaced,
# once the new one has arrived.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) asset=rathole-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip ;;
    aarch64) asset=rathole-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.zip ;;
    *) fail "rathole has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag rathole-org/rathole "$tag") || fail "rathole has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.5.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -x rathole ] && ./rathole --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "Build Version: *$version"; then
    echo "rathole $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading rathole $version"
    gh-release download rathole-org/rathole "$tag" "$asset" "$work/rathole.zip" || fail "rathole $version has no download for this CPU."
    unzip -q -o "$work/rathole.zip" -d "$work/x"
    [ -f "$work/x/rathole" ] || fail "The download isn't rathole. Reinstall to try again."
    chmod +x "$work/x/rathole"
    mv -f "$work/x/rathole" rathole
fi

if [ ! -f server.toml ]; then
    token=$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '\n/+=')
    cat > server.toml <<TOML
# rathole's server settings: https://github.com/rathole-org/rathole#configuration
# rathole reloads this file when it changes.
[server]
# Raptor sets this to the server's port at every start. Clients connect here.
bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:2333"
# The token clients need, unless a service sets its own. Raptor made a
# random one; copy it into each client's client.toml.
default_token = "$token"

[server.services]
# One block per service you expose. Each one's port must be one of the
# server's ports in the Panel, and the client's service must have the same
# name. For example, to expose a client's SSH on this server's port 2222:
#
# [server.services.ssh]
# bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:2222"
TOML
    chmod 600 server.toml
    echo "Wrote a first server.toml with a random token."
fi
echo "Installed rathole $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The rathole version to install, such as 0.5.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: How much rathole writes to the console: error, warn, info, debug or trace.
